metadata.Name: Russian Firms’ Financial Statements Dataset (RFSD)
metadata.Description: A large-scale panel dataset of Russian firms’ financial statements for 2012-2021. The dataset is based on data from the Federal Tax Service of Russia’s State Information Resource of Financial Statements (GIR BO) and contains over 43 million firm-year observations for eligible firms.
metadata.Paper Title: The Russian Firms’ Financial Statements Dataset (RFSD)
metadata.Abstract: We present the Russian Firms’ Financial Statements Dataset (RFSD), a new large-scale panel dataset of Russian firms’ financial statements for 2012-2021. The dataset is based on the data from the Federal Tax Service of Russia’s State Information Resource of Financial Statements (GIR BO). The dataset contains financial statements for over 240,000 unique firms, resulting in over 1.2 million firm-year observations. In addition to the raw data, we provide a set of variables that can be used to assess the quality of the data and to identify potential data issues. We also provide a set of scripts that can be used to replicate the dataset and to perform some basic data analysis. We believe that the RFSD will be a valuable resource for researchers studying the Russian economy.
